case_name: Dr. Beoncy Laishram vs The State Of Manipur

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dr. Beoncy Laishram, aged about 32 years, D/o Laishram Nabachandra Singh R/o Kakwa Laiphrakpam Leikai, Maibam Leikai, Imphal West, Manipur-795008 — Petitioner
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Manipur, represented by the Commissioner (Education) (H&T), Govt. of Manipur, Secretariat, Imphal, Manipur-795001; The Director, Directorate of Education (School), Govt. of Manipur, Lamphelpat, Imphal, Manipur-795004; The Chairman, Board of Secondary Education Manipur, Babupara, Imphal West Pin code-795001; The Chairman, Council of Higher Secondary Education Manipur, Babupara, Imphal West Pin code-795001; The Registrar, Manipur University, Indo-Myanmar Road, Canchipur-795003, Imphal, Manipur, India; The Registrar, Manipur Medical Council, Medical Directorate complex, Lamphel, Imphal West, Manipur-795001 — Respondents

facts_of_case: A transgender person seeks to update and correct their original name recorded in educational qualification certificates and other official documents by the new name and gender.

legal_principles.principle: Correction in education certificate should start from the initial stage i.e. matriculation stage.
legal_principles.held: It is clarified that any correction in the education certificate has to be initiated from the initial stage i.e. matriculation stage and correction cannot be undertaken at the intermediate stage.

legal_principles.principle: The refusal to change name and gender is by the issuing authority.
legal_principles.held: It is clarified that any correction in the education certificate has to be initiated from the initial stage i.e. matriculation stage and correction cannot be undertaken at the intermediate stage.
use_in: cases involving name and gender changes

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that they have concealed material facts.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the decision of other High Courts are not binding on this Court. Hence, the petitioner has no right to change gender and name in the education certificate issued in her original name and gender and the present writ petition be dismissed on this ground.
use_in: cases involving concealment of material facts

outcome.final_order: The court allows the writ petition, holding that a transgender person is entitled to update and correct their original name recorded in educational qualification certificates and other official documents by the new name and gender.
